comment: Huber Eulerwiege 512.1 Eulerian cradle, real vendor CAD rigged by tools/cad/rig_articulation.py. Joint names come from the live articulation. Soft limits sit INSIDE the physical joint limits in tools/cad/kinematics/huber_512_1.json (chi +/-100 deg, phi +/-180 deg, z +/-10 mm). retry_deadband values are MEASURED on the running model, at roughly 5x the settled residual error: chi 0.0013 deg, phi 0.0026 deg, z 0.00018 mm, each measured once at mid-travel. The drive gains they depend on are still estimates, so re-measure after changing a mass or a gain -- and note these were taken at a single position, where the ring is close to balanced about its own axis. An axis carrying a gravity load off-axis will rest further short.
